answer: To resist sybils, an agent economy binds each identity to a real compute deposit: a gale of cheap clones cannot outbid one honest agent because every new persona pays a fresh proof that is burned if it turns out fake. A verified lagoon of reputation, sealed by peer countersignatures, lets any observer replay the chain and spot duplicate identities, while a lotus of governance votes stays one-per-established-agent, so fabricating a crowd buys no extra voice.
